And yet...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}We have to bring order to the world as fast as we can, or the soul of {name:0180}-sama, wandering in Remiel-sama's keeping, will never rest!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

Maybe something happened.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Angel, what should we do? I think the hero can be found, so if needed, order Find Hero.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{name:0180} ran away from home...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Well, I think they'll be back after a while... What a pain, honestly.{n}{wait}{clear}Maybe you could ask Titania-sama to give them a good talking-to.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0680}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Angel... I'm back.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Um... I got a little tired... So... um...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Um... Angel, I'm sorry, I apologize, please forgive me! Shelly regrets it more deeply than the sea!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0380}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Angel, the soul of {name:0180}-sama is gone from Remiel-sama's keeping...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{name:0180}-sama can never come back to Infos now...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}For the sake of the late {name:0180}-sama, we have to scout a new hero and lead Infos to peace!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0780}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Angel, the Stagnation of Time has gotten bad, and the land of Infos is falling to ruin.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}If it keeps getting worse, Infos will collapse before ten years have passed!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}We have to bring peace to Infos with the heroes, even a little sooner!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
